faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Defender Td5 use?
faqLeft.a: The Defender Td5 uses the Td5 engine — a 2.5-litre five-cylinder diesel, fitted from 1998 to 2007 across the 90/110/130 range. Send us your registration and we'll confirm your exact spec.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Defender Td5 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £1,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Defender Td5?
faqLeft.a: The Td5 is the engine code — entered on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Td5 Defender engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace injectors, the head gasket, cooling system components and timing chain as standard on every Td5 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Defender Td5 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Defender Td5 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Defender Td5 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Defender Td5 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
